purpose: Teach: 本稿/索引/貯蔵/税源/不服/優待/競売/課金

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本稿の修正を社内で議論しろ
lines.en: I want you to discuss the revisions to this proposal internally.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Clear enunciation on the key verb. No pause — the instruction flows with authority that doesn't need to be asserted. Composed eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品カタログの索引を整備しております
lines.en: Understood. We're currently organizing the product catalog index.
lines.style: Respectful but steady. Slight lift on the acknowledgment. Report-like cadence, matter-of-fact. Shows he has the task in hand without volunteering extra.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、在庫貯蔵庫の温度管理を徹底しろ
lines.en: Make sure we maintain strict temperature control in the storage facility.
lines.style: Firm, no-room-for-compromise tone. Sharp attack on the instruction itself. Slow enough to land. This is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規税源開拓の調査を進めております
lines.en: Understood. We're currently conducting a survey on new revenue sources.
lines.style: Calm, professional report. Even pacing. Acknowledges the directive while showing parallel work underway. Competent, unruffled.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お客様の不服に丁寧に対応しろ
lines.en: Handle customer complaints with care and consideration.
lines.style: Even tone, almost quiet. The emphasis is on the responsibility itself, not the rebuke. One who expects this standard without needing to enforce it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。優待制度を会員様に新設いたしました
lines.en: Understood. We've just established a new loyalty program for our members.
lines.style: Steady, with a small note of quiet accomplishment. Delivered without seeking praise but with clear evidence of completed work. Straightforward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競売参加のため資金を準備しろ
lines.en: Secure funding in preparation for the auction.
lines.style: Decisive, economical. Short, sharp phrasing. The kind of order that admits no debate — important and immediate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新サービスの課金体系を整えました
lines.en: Understood. We've finalized the billing structure for the new service.
lines.style: Clear, definitive close. A sense of completion on the final statement. Professional but warm — the kind of answer that ends the meeting well.
